newsitem.title: USA: Applied Materials to expand Austin site.
newsitem.headline: Applied Materials to expand Austin site.

text.p: Applied Materials Inc said on Thursday that it plans to more than double the size of its primary manufacturing site in Austin, Texas to meet demand for its wafer fabrication systems.

Applied Materials will complete a $45 million 258,000-square-foot building in August and a new 310,000-square-foot building, with each structure featuring a 65,000-square-foot cleanroom manufacturing area.

The 310,000 square-foot building will cost about $45 million to build and construction will begin in September, said company spokesman Steve Taylor. Manufacturing is expected to begin in Spring 1998, the company said.
More than one million square feet of manufacturing space is proposed in Austin, Applied Materials said in a statement.
Currently, Applied Materials' Austin three-building campus provides 552,000 square feet with approximately 1,800 manufacturing employees.
Applied Materials said it has several hundred job openings, but a total figure has not yet been determined, Taylor said.
